provenance_caveat: Real OKX exchange data, non-synthetic; cross-venue vs Hyperliquid spec; NOT Hyperliquid performance evidence.
method: Exact full-portfolio robustness stress: leave-one-symbol-out and leave-one-trade-out re-run the real portfolio engine with all other signals intact; concentration-adjusted inference; bootstrap + analytic power projection; expanding-window refit walk-forward.

leave_one_symbol_out.method: mask every signal of the excluded symbol, re-run the exact portfolio engine

leave_one_trade_out.method: mask one admitted trade's signal, re-run the exact portfolio engine

walkforward.method: expanding-window prefixes from bar 0 (warmup preserved); canonical config and a 27-point execution-knob refit grid selected in-sample per prefix, then evaluated on the next block out-of-sample. Blocks with no new trades are skipped, not scored as zero.

walkforward.refit_scope: execution/portfolio knobs only; signal generation fixed at spec config

limitations: 8 trades across 5 symbols is a very small sample; LOO/LOTO re-runs cannot create information the sample does not contain.
The bootstrap/power projection assumes future trades and symbols are drawn from the observed distribution; it is a sample-size calculation, not evidence of edge.
The refit walk-forward varies execution/portfolio knobs only; signal generation is fixed at the canonical spec config (RSI<20, 9% target, 8x safety stop).
Expanding-window prefixes start at bar 0 and preserve RSI warmup; trades that open in a block but do not exit by the block end are not counted.
Cross-venue OKX cache; NOT Hyperliquid performance evidence.
